headline: Arkansas-Pine Bluff allows more goals than any two programs
dek: Even VMI and Chicago State, the next highest in the Southern and Northeast conferences, conceded fewer goals together than the SWAC side did alone. Arkansas-Pine Bluff's season is over, leaving that defensive total unmatched across the division.
